nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

## Model Links
[🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

**vae**

- [minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors)
- [minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/vae/minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors)

**diffusion_models**

- [minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/diffusion_models/minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors)

**text_encoders**

- [qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/text_encoders/qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors)

**loras**

- 4 steps: [minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/resolve/main/loras/minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors)

**embeddings**

- [10 style embeddings](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3/tree/main/embeddings) (`minimaxh3_*.safetensors`), for example `minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

## Model Storage Location

```
📂 ComfyUI/
├── 📂 models/
│   ├── 📂 vae/
│   │   ├── minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16.safetensors
│   │   └── minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 diffusion_models/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 text_encoders/
│   │   └── qwen3vl_32b_minimax_h3_nvfp4_awq.safetensors
│   ├── 📂 loras/
│   │   └── minimax_h3_ref2v_turbo_4step_v0.1_comfyui_bf16.safetensors
│   └── 📂 embeddings/
│       └── minimaxh3_art_is_explosion.safetensors
```

## Using Prompt Embeddings

Prompt embeddings (supported since [ComfyUI#15697](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15697)) add reusable style tokens to your prompt. Download one or more embeddings from the folder above into `ComfyUI/models/embeddings/`, then reference one in the prompt text with the `embedding:` prefix and the filename without its extension, for example:

`embedding:minimaxh3_art_is_explosion`

Using an embedding is optional and the template runs fine without one.

## Report Issue

Note: Please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud updates follow stable releases, so some nightly-supported models may not be available yet.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is Riot, the single woman defined by <Picture 1> and continued from <Video 1>. Preserve her facial identity, light eyes, short disordered copper-red hair, lean athletic proportions, black cropped leather jacket, black shirt, rain-wet condition, and controlled alert physicality.

<Subject 2> is the single Quorum manifestation defined by <Picture 2> and continued from <Video 1>. It is an uncannily tall elongated feline-hominid figure wearing layered black ceremonial robes, a deep patterned hood, dark metallic collars, chains, and circular pendants. Its feline face remains recessed inside the hood.

<Subject 3> is the stormbound Highland Orrery installation established by <Picture 3> and <Video 1>, including the wet black-stone platform, massive dark monoliths, partial brass Orrery structure, wind-driven rain, low storm ceiling, and cold desaturated natural light.

<Video 1> is the immediate visual and audio-continuity source. It provides the final two-shot between Riot and the Quorum, their positions across the Orrery, the completed line “We are,” the decaying breath-derived harmonic texture, the storm ambience, and the current cloud state.

<Audio 1> is the two-performer voice-timbre reference for <Subject 2> (S2). Use both recorded human voices as closely synchronized components of one unified Quorum vocal identity, producing one intelligible layered whisper rather than two separate speakers.

<Audio 2> is the synchronized sound from <Video 1>, referenced specifically for the decaying harmonic tail after “We are,” the Highland rain and wind, distant thunder, and restrained Orrery mechanics.

summary:
[video continuation + reference generation + audio reference] The target video continues directly from <Video 1>. A medium close-up shows the Quorum silently shifting its gaze upward before commanding Riot to “Heed.” A close-up shows Riot recognizing the cue and following its gaze. The scene then cuts to a low-angle rear view behind Riot as the storm ceiling darkens and begins separating, preparing the following planetary reveal.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 2] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - preserve Riot’s identity, wet copper-red hair, black clothing, controlled performance, and gradual upward eyeline movement.

<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1] and [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - preserve one Quorum figure with its deep hood, elongated feline-hominid anatomy, layered black robes, metallic ornaments, restrained movement, and calm authority.

<Subject 3> (appears throughout): fully_preserved - preserve the wet stone installation, monumental pillars, partial Orrery structure, rain, cold storm lighting, and slowly changing cloud ceiling.

<Video 1> (continuity, positions, lighting, weather, and audio transition): fully_preserved - continue directly from its final state while introducing three deliberate camera angles.

<Audio 1>: reference - use the two source voices to guide the Quorum’s fused whisper timbre and concise delivery of “Heed” without copying the source signal.

<Audio 2>: reference - continue the breath-harmonic decay and environmental acoustic character established at the end of <Video 1> without repeating its completed dialogue.

detailed_description:
The target video uses restrained photorealistic science-fiction cinematography, compressed portrait framing followed by a wide low-angle reveal setup, realistic wet materials, subtle facial performance, and precise synchronized stereo sound. Generate an 8-second clip.

[Shot 1] Continue directly after <Video 1> with a clean hard cut to a locked 90mm medium close-up of <Subject 2> from a slight left-facing three-quarter angle. Frame the Quorum from the upper chest upward. Its deep patterned hood surrounds the recessed feline face, while rain moves softly through the foreground and cold highlights trace the dark metal collars and circular pendants.

The final breath-derived harmonic from <Audio 2> continues quietly for approximately 0.600 seconds and decays into the storm ambience.

The Quorum remains still for one brief beat. Its eyes move upward first, its eyeshine a feline green reflection of the light around it. Its hooded head then follows with one small, slow, exact elevation toward the sky. The movement is controlled and economical, as though it has already perceived something far beyond Riot’s senses.

At approximately 00:01.150, <Subject 2> (S2) says, <d>[English] Heed.</d> The word uses the unified voice timbre guided by <Audio 1>: one clear dry central whisper reinforced by several very quiet near-unison doubles spread subtly across the stereo field. The consonant is precise and intimate. The vowel broadens slightly, then ends cleanly. The visible mouth remains still.

As the Quorum speaks, a low distant thunder roll begins near its screen-right position and travels gradually toward the center of the stereo field. The sound is soft but spatially distinct, functioning as an acoustic extension of the Quorum’s upward gaze.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.350, cut to an 85mm close-up of <Subject 1> in right-facing three-quarter profile. Riot remains focused on the Quorum for approximately 0.2500 seconds after the command. She does not immediately understand.

Her eyes then track the Quorum’s eyeline upward. Her brow relaxes slightly from confrontation into wary attention. Her chin lifts and her head follows. Her breathing becomes audible for one controlled inhale. A broad moving cloud shadow darkens the upper portion of her wet face while the lower storm light remains cold and diffuse.

The traveling thunder broadens across both stereo channels as Riot completes the upward movement.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.450, cut to a 28mm low-angle rear three-quarter wide shot positioned behind and slightly below Riot. <Subject 1> occupies the lower center-left of frame from the shoulders upward, her wet copper-red hair and black jacket forming a clear silhouette against the storm ceiling. <Subject 2> stands farther away in the lower right portion of frame beside a dark monolith, also looking upward. Partial brass arcs and supports from the Orrery frame the lower edges of the image.

Apply a slow upward camera tilt of approximately twelve degrees, following Riot’s gaze into the sky.

The upper cloud layers move laterally in broad heavy formations while the lower cloud layers churn more slowly around the monoliths. The center of the storm ceiling darkens. Two massive cloud banks begin drawing apart with slow gravitational weight, forming a narrow vertical seam of deeper atmosphere and a pitch black sky behind the clouds above the Orrery.

The wind at ground level decreases slightly while a broader high-altitude air movement becomes audible across the full stereo field. The sound grows spatially wider as the camera tilts upward. Deep cloud turbulence and distant thunder replace the earlier intimate dialogue focus.

End with Riot and the Quorum both looking above frame, the camera aimed into the darkening seam between the cloud banks. The opening remains filled with deep storm atmosphere, ready for the next clip to continue the cloud separation and reveal the Quorum homeworld.

overall_soundscape:
Reference <Audio 2> for continuous Highland rain, low wind, distant storm pressure, and restrained Orrery mechanics. Begin with the decaying harmonic tail established after “We are.” The Quorum’s word “Heed” remains dry, intimate, intelligible, layered, and spatially broader than ordinary speech. A low thunder roll travels from the Quorum’s screen position toward the center as Riot follows its gaze. During the final low-angle shot, reduce close ground-level wind and broaden the high-altitude storm sound across the stereo field, creating an audible transition from intimate conversation to immense sky-scale movement.

non_diegetic_music:
N/A. The decaying harmonic at the opening is the residual vocal texture from the Quorum’s preceding speech, not a separate score.
